states.dedicated: At least one durable audit is centered on evidence from this field. This does not mean the field is complete.
states.adjacent: The field contributes evidence to another audit, but has no field-centered audit of its own.
states.unreviewed: No durable field-centered evidence audit is present. Mentions and source leads do not count.

oecdFord.title: OECD Fields of Research and Development (FORD)

anzsrc.title: Australian and New Zealand Standard Research Classification (ANZSRC)
anzsrc.role: Independent division-level census and taxonomy-disagreement probe

oecdFields.name: Mathematics
oecdFields.scopeGap: Mathematical practice and formal discovery are audited; most mathematical subfields remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which structures from topology, category theory, geometry, and constructive mathematics change representation or verification rather than merely renaming it?

oecdFields.name: Computer and information sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Several systems fields are covered; networking, compilers, visualization, and software engineering remain uneven.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which mature information-system mechanisms are still missing as null models for the proposed architecture?

oecdFields.name: Physical sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Statistical physics, optics, acoustics, soft matter, and particle/nuclear experimental methodology are represented; quantum information, much condensed-matter, atomic/molecular, plasma, accelerator, and nuclear-structure breadth remain partial or absent.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which results survive explicit selection, detector response, nuisance, search-family, simulation, preservation, symmetry, and regime-breakdown tests?

oecdFields.name: Chemical sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Reaction networks, proofreading, bounded molecular synthesis/control, polymer populations, viscoelastic spectra, phase/self-assembly paths, gels, dynamic networks, healing, sequence storage and circularity are represented; analytical, surface, electrochemical and theoretical chemistry plus inorganic, organometallic, total-synthesis and scale-up breadth remain uneven.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which chemical control mechanisms survive explicit speciation, pathway, apparatus, operator, candidate-set, transport and lifecycle qualification?

oecdFields.name: Earth and related environmental sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Geology, geomorphology, mineralogy/petrology/geochemistry, transition signals, and remote inference are represented; oceanography, hydrology, meteorology, geophysics, geodesy, and much experimental mineral physics remain uneven.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: How do sparse, delayed, transformed, and preservation-filtered observations distinguish local variation, material path, source mixture, and regime change across coupled scales?

oecdFields.name: Biological sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: This is the most heavily sampled broad field, but genomics, marine biology, anatomy, physiology, parasitology, and many taxa remain incomplete.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which mechanisms survive normalization across unrelated lineages and which are artifacts of shared ancestry or laboratory choice?

oecdFields.name: Other natural sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Hybrid natural-science material exists, but the residual category has never been explicitly searched for fields omitted by the named FORD classes.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which emerging or hybrid natural sciences fall outside the named classes and expose a missing problem family?

oecdFields.name: Civil engineering
oecdFields.scopeGap: Resilience and occupied systems are represented; construction production, geotechnics, water engineering, and long-life asset governance remain partial.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which inspection, reserve, staged repair, and graceful-service mechanisms transfer to long-lived adaptive systems?

oecdFields.name: Electrical engineering, electronic engineering, information engineering
oecdFields.scopeGap: Power, device reliability, adaptive link control, and interacting network-loop operations are represented; RF device and antenna design, signal processing, sensors, electromagnetic compatibility, and control hardware remain uneven.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which protection, coding, state-age, and loop-coordination mechanisms preserve accepted service with less sensing, communication, and margin?

oecdFields.name: Mechanical engineering
oecdFields.scopeGap: Mechanics and resilience plus bounded production-process, RCM, maintainability, support and restoration evidence are represented; tribology, machine design, thermal machines, factory systems and process-specific manufacturing remain shallow.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: When can geometry, compliance, hysteresis, passive dynamics, maintainability, or mode-specific maintenance replace sensing, active control, and universal service schedules?

oecdFields.name: Chemical engineering
oecdFields.scopeGap: Plantwide control and balances are represented; scale-up, separations, catalysis, fouling, and batch operation remain partial.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which conservation-qualified decomposition and fault isolation methods constrain learned process modules?

oecdFields.name: Materials engineering
oecdFields.scopeGap: Adaptive materials, polymer distributions/topology/rheology/healing, device degradation, and bounded material qualification/lineage are represented; metallurgy, ceramics, composites, joining, coatings, and most production physics remain shallow.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which functions can be compiled into material response without losing distribution support, inspectability, repairability, remaining-life knowledge, or lifecycle advantage?

oecdFields.name: Medical engineering
oecdFields.scopeGap: Biomechanical control touches the field, but devices, imaging, prosthetics, clinical instrumentation, and validation are not audited as engineering systems.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: How do assistive and diagnostic systems share control, calibrate uncertainty, and fail safely across changing bodies?

oecdFields.name: Environmental engineering
oecdFields.scopeGap: Environmental phenomena and industrial processes are separate audits; remediation, water treatment, waste systems, and environmental monitoring are not.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which distributed treatment and monitoring strategies allocate intervention under uncertain transport and delayed feedback?

oecdFields.name: Environmental biotechnology
oecdFields.scopeGap: Engineered groundwater remediation, intervention, transport, product/mass endpoints, rebound, and open-system evolutionary failure are audited; wastewater, gaseous emissions, mining, marine systems, containment, and environmental-release breadth remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which intervention effects survive alternative transport paths, daughter products, oxygen ingress, invasion, succession, off-site export, monitoring designs, and post-treatment rebound?

oecdFields.name: Industrial biotechnology
oecdFields.scopeGap: Strain burden/escape, fermentation, continuous culture, cybergenetic control, scale-up, separation, and lifecycle boundaries are audited; cell therapy, food fermentation, enzyme manufacture, product validation, contamination control, and manufacturing authorization remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which production-control results survive lineage drift, escape mutation, scale gradients, sensor distortion, transport limits, fouling, off-spec propagation, cleaning, and full seed-to-retirement cost?

oecdFields.name: Nano-technology
oecdFields.scopeGap: Nanoscale assembly mechanisms plus a bounded direct audit of population distributions, measurement operators, process history, and rare manufacturing defects are represented; nanodevice transport and sensing, toxicology, safety, fabrication breadth, and scale-up remain incomplete.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which nanoscale assembly, sensing, transport, inspection, and defect-control mechanisms retain calibrated population evidence and lifecycle advantage after fabrication costs are included?

oecdFields.name: Other engineering and technologies
oecdFields.scopeGap: Safety-critical autonomy is represented; the residual engineering class is open-ended and cannot be considered exhausted.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which engineering professions use mature operating constraints absent from the current null-model library?

oecdFields.name: Basic medicine
oecdFields.scopeGap: Several regulatory systems are represented; anatomy, general physiology, genetics, metabolism, and disease mechanisms remain uneven.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which multi-organ control and maintenance mechanisms expose cross-module dependencies missing from neural analogies?

oecdFields.name: Clinical medicine
oecdFields.scopeGap: Pathology, rehabilitation, pharmacology, multimorbidity, diagnostic-to-action coupling, adaptive treatment pathways, antimicrobial stewardship, and intervention authorization now have bounded direct entries; surgery, most specialties, longitudinal disease management, and much diagnostic and therapeutic practice remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which staged test, authorization, realized-treatment, monitoring, and stopping contracts improve person-level and population outcomes under incomplete observation, interactions, and bounded support?

oecdFields.name: Health sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Surveillance plus a first nursing, care-continuity, and health-services audit are represented; occupational health, nutrition, implementation science, long-term care, community care, and most clinical service designs remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which mechanisms preserve necessary service and legitimate person-level authority across community, long-term, acute, and digital care without hiding unfinished work or unpaid human burden?

oecdFields.name: Medical biotechnology
oecdFields.scopeGap: Cellular mechanisms are audited as biology, not engineered diagnostics, therapeutics, tissue systems, or manufacturing.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which engineered-cell and molecular-device control mechanisms remain stable, containable, and measurable in living hosts?

oecdFields.name: Other medical science
oecdFields.scopeGap: Exercise and performance science provide adjacent material, but the residual medical category has not been searched systematically.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which clinical or care disciplines fall outside the named classes and contribute distinct coordination or evidence mechanisms?

oecdFields.name: Agriculture, forestry, and fisheries
oecdFields.scopeGap: Soil/crop co-limitation, forestry, capture fisheries, aquaculture, and aquatic resource management have direct audits; silvicultural breadth, inland fisheries, pest management, livestock integration, farm economics, and many production systems remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which policies remain effective across alternative population, spatial, climate, observation, implementation, rights, and market models without exporting harm or changing the denominator?

oecdFields.name: Animal and dairy science
oecdFields.scopeGap: Resource partitioning, cattle feed restriction, welfare measurement, breeding diversity, rumen consortia, and population-event accounting are audited; species breadth, husbandry systems, reproduction, farm economics, and fisheries remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which findings survive across species, production systems, lifetimes, protected welfare components, reproductive constraints, and start-cohort denominators?

oecdFields.name: Veterinary science
oecdFields.scopeGap: Risk-based and One-Health surveillance, infection interference, evolving opponents, welfare, and dynamical identifiability are audited; comparative clinical care, surgery, companion and wildlife medicine, pharmacovigilance, and antimicrobial stewardship remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: How do diagnosis, treatment, movement, surveillance, welfare, transmission, and resistance interact across species and changing target populations?

oecdFields.name: Agricultural biotechnology
oecdFields.scopeGap: Genomic selection, microbial intervention, vaccination, and evolutionary response provide adjacent evidence; gene editing, reproductive biotechnology, diagnostics, biological control, product platforms, and authorization remain unaudited.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which intervention effects remain after lineage concentration, off-target change, evolutionary response, containment, field transfer, and authorization are tested prospectively?

oecdFields.name: Other agricultural sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Aquatic food systems and cross-resource governance provide a direct residual-field audit; rural studies, extension science, food logistics, agricultural education, and other residual specialties remain open.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which residual agricultural disciplines change observation, authority, adoption, service, distribution, and long-horizon resilience beyond production output?

oecdFields.name: Psychology and cognitive sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Cognition, learning, and generation are represented; social, organizational, clinical, developmental, and differential psychology remain uneven.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which cognitive effects survive representative tasks, prospective testing, and selection-bias controls?

oecdFields.name: Economics and business
oecdFields.scopeGap: Markets, operations, accounting identities, audit and assurance boundaries, actuarial reserves, insurance selection and incentives, correlated tails, and solvency governance are represented; finance, management, marketing, taxation, organization design, and empirical institutional breadth remain shallow.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which findings survive endogenous reporting, delayed obligations, correlated shocks, model misspecification, conflicting roles, and independently challengeable evidence?

oecdFields.name: Education
oecdFields.scopeGap: Learning and skill acquisition are represented; institutions, curriculum, inclusion, teacher coordination, and assessment systems remain partial.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: How should an adaptive system sequence practice, feedback, assessment, support, and transfer under heterogeneous learning histories?

oecdFields.name: Sociology
oecdFields.scopeGap: Direct social-research methods plus bounded stratification, household allocation, paid/unpaid work, migration measurement, collective-action, criminology, and digital-field entries are represented; education, urban/rural and health sociology, science and technology studies, social work, historical sociology, population breadth, and most substantive theory remain incomplete.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which substantive sociological results survive explicit construct, inequality operator, household allocation, migration denominator, participation cost, crime-observation, platform, positionality, and shared-error-root tests?

oecdFields.name: Law
oecdFields.scopeGap: Evidence and procedure are represented; substantive EU/German fields, remedies, administration, competition, labour, and criminal law remain partial.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which contestability and burden-of-proof mechanisms should govern automated decisions and scientific promotion?

oecdFields.name: Political science
oecdFields.scopeGap: Formal governance plus bounded policy-implementation, administrative-burden, participation, collective-action, and repression mechanisms are represented; parties, elections, legislatures, executives, courts, comparative regimes, international relations, conflict, public finance, and policy breadth remain incomplete.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: How do authority, veto, capture, administrative burden, participation cost, legitimacy, and implementation gaps change governance designs without treating visible action as private support?

oecdFields.name: Social and economic geography
oecdFields.scopeGap: Urban and demographic systems touch the field, but spatial inequality, mobility, place, scale, and regional change are not field-centered.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which spatial aggregation and mobility mechanisms create misleading global state from locally unequal access and exposure?

oecdFields.name: Media and communications
oecdFields.scopeGap: Communication mechanisms plus bounded platform-conditioned methods and comparative media-system operators are represented; journalism practice and history, media industries, interpersonal, intercultural, organizational, health and environmental communication, and audience breadth remain incomplete.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: How do channels, provider-controlled interfaces, media institutions, platforms, gatekeepers, ownership, financing, incentives, and repeated exposure alter observation, shared state, and error propagation?

oecdFields.name: Other social sciences
oecdFields.scopeGap: Human factors and organizational work provide adjacent material, but the residual social-science category has not been searched systematically.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which professions and hybrid social sciences contribute distinct observation, coordination, or accountability mechanisms?

oecdFields.name: History and archaeology
oecdFields.scopeGap: Material inference and quantitative history are represented; archival criticism, period-specific methods, oral history, and history of science remain partial.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: How should path dependence, missing archives, provenance, survivorship, and changing categories constrain learned historical memory?

oecdFields.name: Languages and literature
oecdFields.scopeGap: Linguistics, textual criticism, variant traditions, scholarly editing, and translation qualification are represented; narrative theory, poetics, comparative literature, reception, performance, and most language traditions remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which narrative and interpretive structures change counterfactual evaluation, perspective, compression, long-range coherence, or disagreement handling beyond the new witness-variant contract?

oecdFields.name: Philosophy, ethics and religion
oecdFields.scopeGap: Philosophy of science, theory choice, theology, religious practice, and ritual now have field-centered audits; ethics, philosophy of mind and technology, comparative theology, and most religious traditions remain unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which accounts of agency, moral status, value conflict, testimony, interpretation, conscience, and authority change system governance or evaluation contracts?

oecdFields.name: Arts (arts, history of arts, performing arts, music)
oecdFields.scopeGap: Visual art and music are represented; theatre, dance, film, architecture as art, conservation, and art history remain uneven.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which embodied, temporal, collaborative, and material practices produce useful variants and evaluations unavailable to static generation?

oecdFields.name: Other humanities
oecdFields.scopeGap: A deliberate residual-category audit now samples living heritage, rehearsal, conservation, archival absence, and digital preservation; the catch-all remains open and most direct humanities practices are still unsampled.
oecdFields.nextQuestion: Which methods from oral history, museum and curatorial practice, film, theatre and dance traditions, folklore, interpreting, conservation science, and heritage conflict change a test rather than duplicate provenance, governance, or protocol versioning?

dfgReviewBoards.name: Alte Kulturen
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Archaeological inference is present, but ancient-culture detail remains sparse.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Geschichtswissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Historical method breadth remains partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Kunst-, Musik-, Theater- und Medienwissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Theatre and media studies are not directly audited.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Sprachwissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Historical and typological breadth remains partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Literaturwissenschaft
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Textual criticism, scholarly editing, variant traditions, and translation qualification are audited; literary theory and most genres and traditions remain unsampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Sozial- und Kulturanthropologie, außereuropäische Kulturen, Judaistik und Religionswissenschaft
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Religious practice and ritual have a field-centered audit, but ethnography, anthropology, Judaic studies, non-European cultures, and comparative religious studies remain unsampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Theologie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Practice, ritual, interpretation, canon, authority, conscience, and evidence boundaries are audited; doctrinal, historical, pastoral, comparative, and tradition-specific theology remain unsampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Philosophie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Philosophy of science and theory choice are audited; most other philosophical subfields remain unsampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Erziehungswissenschaft und Bildungsforschung
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Institutions and professional practice remain partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Psychologie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Clinical, organizational, and personality work remain uneven.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Sozialwissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Empirical social research plus bounded policy implementation, administrative burden, inequality, household/work/care allocation, migration, collective action, criminology, platform methods and media-system operators are represented; parties, elections, comparative politics, international relations, journalism practice/history, media industries, education, urban/rural and health sociology, social work, and most substantive breadth remain incomplete.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Wirtschaftswissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Market design, operations, accounting, audit, actuarial reserves, and insurance boundaries are audited; finance, management, marketing, taxation, organization studies, and much empirical institutional work remain unsampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Rechtswissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Evidence and procedure dominate; substantive fields remain partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Grundlagen der Biologie und Medizin
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Genomics and structural biology remain uneven.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Pflanzenwissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Field and crop contexts remain partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Zoologie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Behavior and navigation are present, but morphology, systematics, physiology, and evo-devo are not field-centered.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Mikrobiologie, Virologie und Immunologie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Virology and parasitology are major gaps.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Medizin
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Pathology, rehabilitation, pharmacology, multimorbidity, diagnostic-to-action coupling, adaptive treatment pathways, antimicrobial stewardship, and intervention authorization have bounded entries; only a small fraction of the 33 listed medical subjects is directly sampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Neurowissenschaften
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Strongest life-science concentration; still not exhaustive.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Agrar-, Forstwissenschaften und Tiermedizin
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Soil/crop co-limitation, animal production, welfare, breeding, rumen ecology, veterinary population health, forestry, fisheries, aquaculture, and aquatic food systems are audited; many species, production systems, food science, farm economics, and clinical veterinary breadth remain unsampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Molekülchemie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Dynamic covalent assembly, self-sorting, context-qualified recognition, photochemical/electrochemical pathway control, structure elucidation and automated discovery nulls now have a bounded audit; inorganic/organometallic breadth, total synthesis, radical/pericyclic/C–H activation, flow/scale-up, impurity fate and reproducibility remain incomplete.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Chemische Festkörper- und Oberflächenforschung
dfgReviewBoards.gap: No surface-chemistry audit.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Physikalische Chemie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Only neighboring reaction and thermodynamic material is present.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Analytische Chemie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Sensor calibration, optical-density distortion, sampling, and mass closure provide adjacent constraints; chemical metrology, calibration hierarchy, detection/quantification limits, matrix effects, speciation, and interlaboratory comparison lack a field-centered audit.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Biologische Chemie und Lebensmittelchemie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Metabolic pathways and edible nutrient/feed-flow accounting provide adjacent evidence; molecular biochemistry, food chemistry, processing, preservation, toxicology, and analytical methods lack a field-centered audit.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Polymerforschung
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Polymerization mechanisms and populations, entanglement, viscoelastic spectra, conditional time–temperature superposition, phase/self-assembly paths, gel criteria, dynamic covalent networks, healing, response, ageing/fatigue, sequence storage, circularity and measurement operators now have a bounded audit; processing/manufacturing, biopolymers, membranes, conducting polymers, adhesion, composite interfaces, toxicology, fire and application qualification remain incomplete.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Theoretische Chemie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Stoichiometric networks, microkinetics, scaling relations, and transport models provide adjacent formalisms; electronic structure, quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, statistical mechanics, and method validation lack a field-centered audit.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Physik der kondensierten Materie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Soft matter and devices cover only a subset.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Statistische Physik, nichtlineare Dynamik, komplexe Systeme, weiche und fluide Materie, biologische Physik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Several components are represented; nonlinear dynamics remains broad.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Optik, Quantenoptik und Physik der Atome, Moleküle und Plasmen
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Optics dominates; atomic and plasma physics remain shallow.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Teilchen, Kerne und Felder
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Triggering, detector response, calibration, unfolding, nuisance uncertainty, rare-event search, blinding, simulation, preservation, evaluated nuclear data, symmetry, and effective-model breakdown are audited; accelerator, detector technology, nuclear structure/reactions, neutrino, astroparticle, phenomenology, and theory breadth remain unsampled.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Astrophysik und Astronomie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Remote inference is represented; field breadth remains partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Mathematik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Practice and proof are represented; subfield breadth is not.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Atmosphären-, Meeres- und Klimaforschung
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Earth-system work plus marine resource and farm-wild coupling are present; ocean physics, biogeochemistry, atmospheric process detail, and climate dynamics remain shallow.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Geologie und Paläontologie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Both have initial audits.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Geophysik und Geodäsie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: No field-centered audit.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Mineralogie, Petrologie und Geochemie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Phase equilibria, kinetic trapping and replacement, P–T–t records, isotope and reservoir inverses, weathering/redox, reactive upscaling, detrital provenance, geochronology, preservation and metrology now have a bounded field audit; experimental mineral physics/crystallography, igneous and mantle processes, ore/economic geology, cosmochemistry, and analytical breadth remain incomplete.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Geographie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Physical and human geography are not audited directly.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Wasserforschung
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Receiving-water capacity and aquatic flows provide adjacent evidence; hydrology, limnology, hydraulics, water treatment, groundwater, and water governance lack a field-centered audit.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Produktionstechnik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Statistical process state, qualified process windows, maintenance policy/support, manufacturing genealogy and bounded nanomanufacturing evidence have a direct audit; factory planning/layout, production logistics, machining, forming, joining, additive manufacture, human work and most process-specific production technologies remain incomplete.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Mechanik und konstruktiver Maschinenbau
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Design and product development remain shallow.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Verfahrenstechnik und Technische Chemie
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Process engineering now includes a direct bioprocess/biotechnology audit; product-specific manufacturing, validation, downstream breadth, contamination control, and industrial authorization remain partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Strömungsmechanik, Technische Thermodynamik und Thermische Energietechnik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Energy machinery and applied thermal systems remain partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Werkstofftechnik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Adaptive-material/polymer mechanisms plus bounded material qualification, inspection-document, lineage, substitution and requalification evidence are represented; metallurgy, ceramics, composites, joining, surface engineering, degradation and most production variation remain incomplete.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Materialwissenschaft
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Adaptive-material, polymer and device-reliability mechanisms are represented; biomaterials, electronic/quantum materials, composite interfaces and multiscale design remain partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Systemtechnik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Transport and microsystems remain uneven.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Power, device reliability, adaptive link control and interacting network-operations loops are represented; antenna/RF device design, electromagnetic compatibility, signal processing, sensors, control hardware and communications-system breadth remain incomplete.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Informatik
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Several subfields are represented; visualization and software engineering remain partial.

dfgReviewBoards.name: Bauwesen und Architektur
dfgReviewBoards.gap: Construction production and water engineering remain partial.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Agricultural, veterinary and food sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Soil, crop, livestock, veterinary population health, forestry, fisheries and aquaculture now have direct audits; food science, farm systems, horticulture, reproductive biotechnology and many species remain unsampled.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Biological sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Cellular control, development, ecology, microbes and plants are represented; taxonomy, anatomy, marine biology, genomics, parasitology and most organismal breadth remain incomplete.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Biomedical and clinical sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Pathology, rehabilitation, pharmacology, toxicology, epidemiology, nursing/care systems, multimorbidity, diagnostic-to-action coupling, adaptive treatment pathways, antimicrobial stewardship and intervention authorization are bounded direct entries; most clinical specialties, surgery, longitudinal disease management and medical biotechnology remain unsampled.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Built environment and design
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Urban systems, structural resilience and design cognition are represented; architecture practice, construction production, landscape architecture, planning law and building operation remain partial.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Chemical sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Reaction networks, proofreading, molecular assembly/control, catalysis, process chemistry and polymer mechanisms are represented; analytical, surface, theoretical and much inorganic, organometallic, total-synthesis and scale-up chemistry remain uneven.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Commerce, management, tourism and services
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Operations, accounting, audit, actuarial reserves and insurance are represented; organization studies, management, marketing, finance, taxation, tourism and most service professions remain unsampled.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Creative arts and writing
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Visual art and music are direct entries, and rehearsal/conservation now have a narrow cross-field probe; writing practice, film, theatre and dance traditions, curating, and most performance research remain unsampled.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Earth sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Geology, geomorphology, mineralogy/petrology/geochemistry, Earth-system transitions and remote inference are represented; geophysics, geodesy, ocean and atmospheric sciences, experimental mineral physics, ore geology and cosmochemistry remain uneven.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Economics
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Market design, incentives and social choice are represented; macroeconomics, development, labor, public finance, economic history and empirical identification breadth remain incomplete.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Education
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Learning and skill acquisition are direct entries; institutions, curriculum, inclusion, assessment, vocational education and comparative education systems remain partial.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Engineering
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Several engineering families plus bounded production/process capability, maintenance/support, nanomanufacturing evidence, adaptive communications/network operations, and material qualification/lineage are represented; mining, transport, factory/layout and production-technology breadth, RF hardware, robotics hardware and many material systems remain uneven.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Environmental sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Earth systems, ecological resilience, remediation and environmental biotechnology are represented; water, ocean, atmospheric, contamination, conservation-management and environmental-policy breadth remain partial.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Health sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Population surveillance, rehabilitation, nursing and health services are represented; public-health interventions, allied health, nutrition, health economics and implementation science remain uneven.

anzsrcDivisions.name: History, heritage and archaeology
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Archaeological inference, quantitative history, textual traditions, living heritage, archival absence and conservation boundaries are represented; oral history, museum and curatorial practice, heritage conflict, and most periods and regions remain unsampled.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Human society
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Direct social-research methods plus bounded policy/administration, political science, inequality, household/work/care allocation, migration, collective action, criminology and digital-field depth are represented; human geography, social work, education, urban/rural and health sociology, historical sociology, comparative politics/international relations, and most substantive anthropology and sociology remain incomplete.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Indigenous studies
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Indigenous data and knowledge governance has an Indigenous-led-source entry audit; languages, law, land, health, education, histories and community-specific knowledge require their own authorities and cannot be inferred from that entry.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Information and computing sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Storage, programming languages, verification, security and HCI are represented; networking, compilers, visualization, software engineering and many applied information systems remain uneven.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Language, communication and culture
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Linguistics, textual criticism, translation qualification, bounded communication/media gatekeeping and effects, platform-conditioned methods, and comparative media-system operators are represented; journalism practice/history, media industries, interpersonal/intercultural/organizational communication, interpreting, cultural studies, rhetoric and most language traditions remain incomplete.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Law and legal studies
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Evidence and procedure are direct entries; substantive private, public, criminal, labor, environmental and international law remain partial and jurisdiction-specific.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Mathematical sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Formal discovery and proof practice are represented; most pure, applied, statistical and computational subfields remain unsampled.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Philosophy and religious studies
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Theory choice, theology, religious practice and ritual are direct entries; ethics, philosophy of mind and technology, comparative religion and most traditions remain unsampled.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Physical sciences
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Thermodynamics, optics, soft matter and particle/nuclear experimental methods are represented; atomic, molecular, plasma, condensed-matter, accelerator and theoretical breadth remain partial.

anzsrcDivisions.name: Psychology
anzsrcDivisions.gap: Cognition, creativity and learning are represented; clinical, personality, developmental, organizational, social and cross-cultural psychology remain uneven.

taxonomyDivergences.name: Indigenous Studies
taxonomyDivergences.gap: Indigenous data and knowledge governance now has an Indigenous-led-source audit. Indigenous Studies is far broader: language, law, health, education, land, history, methods, and community-specific knowledge remain outside this narrow entry audit and require community-specific authority.
taxonomyDivergences.nextQuestion: How can the breadth process include community-defined research questions and authorities without turning Indigenous Studies into extractable motifs or a universal policy template?
taxonomyDivergences.handlingRule: Treat this as a governance and knowledge-sovereignty audit led by Indigenous-authored sources; taxonomy coverage never authorizes extraction of biological or cultural motifs.
